name: WARN Act layoff and closure notices by county: California and Texas
description: How many mass-layoff and plant-closure notices employers filed under the Worker Adjustment and Retraining Notification (WARN) Act, and how many employees they covered, for every county in the states whose workforce agencies publish the notices as files: California (July 2023 on, from the Employment Development Department's reports) and Texas (2019 on, from the Texas Workforce Commission's open-data table). Each county, state and county-not-given record carries the last 12 months, the last complete calendar year, the total since the file starts, and the month-by-month series. Only counts are kept: no employer name, address or contact. Notices are dated by the day the state agency received them.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). WARN Act layoff and closure notices by county: California and Texas (Version 2.0.1) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24116063

distribution.name: warn-layoffs.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: warn-layoffs.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: warn-layoffs-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in warn-layoffs-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to warn-layoffs.csv on id.

recordSet.name: warn-layoffs
recordSet.description: The records of WARN Act layoff and closure notices by county: California and Texas, one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter state code (CA or TX)

field.name: level
field.description: county, county-not-given (blank or out-of-state sites) or state

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: Notices received in the 12 months to the end of the file

field.name: unit
field.description: Unit of value

field.name: warn_notices_12m
field.description: WARN notices received in the 12 months to coverage_to (one per work site)

field.name: warn_employees_12m
field.description: Employees those notices cover, as the employer reported

field.name: last_complete_year
field.description: The last complete calendar year in the file

field.name: warn_notices_last_year
field.description: Notices received in that year

field.name: warn_employees_last_year
field.description: Employees covered in that year

field.name: warn_notices_total
field.description: Notices received since coverage_from

field.name: warn_employees_total
field.description: Employees covered since coverage_from

field.name: coverage_from
field.description: Date of the first notice in the state's file

field.name: coverage_to
field.description: Date of the last notice in the state's file

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: When the fact took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), if known

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: When it stopped applying; empty while current

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: Sources, separated by " | "

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
